pull: Clue: Japan surrendered aboard his flagship
body:
Can you name this man?

On 28 November 1941, this admiral sailed from Pearl Harbor aboard the carrier Enterprise to deliver a dozen Marine Wildcat fighters to Wake Island. At sea he had Battle Order Number One issued: the ship was now operating under war conditions. "Steady nerves and stout hearts are needed now," it said. Pearl Harbor was attacked nine days later.

The clue is on the card. Drop your guess below.
photoNote: Admiral William F. Halsey Jr., portrait, 1944, three years after the event (he was a vice admiral in November 1941). U.S. Navy photo 80-G-165140, NARA (NAID 100311081). Tier: green, U.S. government work, public domain. No name or caption visible.
